commit.message:
Update release-policy.md

This update has three elements:
  1. Adjustments to many references to download mirrors. We are moving from the mirror system to a different content distribution system before the end of 2021.
  2. Updates to certain links. Some pages that were at a.o/dev are now at infra.a.o.
  3. Some edits to improve readability. For instance, the titles of the questions in the FAQ section were a mix of Title case and Sentence case. I have moved them to Sentence case.
